value.title: La tigre solitaria
value.synopsis: As Tiger Mask betrays his former comrades in order to gain a fight against The Third, the latest 5 vs 5 match takes a drastic turn. Monopoly declares war on the NJPW wrestlers by sending in The Third. What will Tiger do?

value.title: La sanzione della tigre!
value.synopsis: The matches begin with NPJW wrestlers versus the Miracles. Tiger Mask faces off in a special match against Miracle IV, who is revealed to be Universal Mask! What is the relationship between The Third and Fukuwara Mask?!

value.title: Resa dei conti! Lo stile Arashi Juken
value.synopsis: Tiger travels to Kyoto in search of a killer move. While there he meets competing heads of a dojo, which is real and who will he side with?!

value.title: Lumberjack
value.synopsis: A 3v3 match between Monoply and NJPW ends in a draw as fighters from both sides commit fouls. Tiger Mask faces off against Miracle 3 in a Lumberjack match, which allows the seconds to assist outside of the ring...but Tiger has no seconds.

value.title: Assassini dal passato
value.synopsis: Monopoly calls in Tiger the Black and Big Tiger the Second. Nagata and Tiger Mask face-off in a 2v2 match, with an unlikely result. Meanwhile, Takuma reaches out to Nagato to help him re-train at his Mt. Fuji facility.

value.title: Grande mischia
value.synopsis: Takuma continues to train at Mt, Fuji, however, the training location is beginning to draw unwanted attention. The final five match battle of the Wars kicks off. One of the wrestlers is missing!

value.title: Esplosione! Zanne della tigre!
value.synopsis: The second battle kicks off after Tiger the Black and Makabe draw. This causes both sides to hangs straetgies and wrestler order. Following the second match, even more order complications happen. Naito cannot make it, but a wrestler comes to he locker room asking to join!

value.title: Quattro Tigri
value.synopsis: Tiger the Dark officially joins the NJPW lineup, making his comeback. After the 3v3 match goes to Monopoly, NJPW are down two matches. With Tanahashi out, NJPW sends out Tiger Mask and Tiger the Dark. Monopoly sends Big Tiger the Second and... The Third!

value.title: Addio Tigre
value.synopsis: The final battle of the War between Monopoly and NJPW is up, but NJPW's wrestlers are injured. As Tiger Mask is selected, his match against the Third is finally happening.

value.title: Masked Tiger Springer
value.synopsis: Following Naoto's victory, he and Takuma look for additional stages to concur. Meanwhile, Haruna and Miss X begin their own wrestling adventure! A Girl's League.
